text: OVERDOSAGE In previous clinical studies, three deaths were reported in patients with severe hemochromatosis who were treated with daily IM Ca-DTPA dosed up to 4 gram per day to reduce iron stores. One patient became comatose and died after receiving a total of 14 gram Ca-DTPA, and the other two died after two weeks of daily treatment. Causal association with these events and the drug has not been established. (See WARNINGS )
